title: Spoken product request to TargetProduct
purpose: Turn a spoken product request into a normalized TargetProduct and maintain it for the session. MVP entry point of the closed loop.
architecturalScope: ProductRequest bounded context. SpeechInputPort + IntentParser + a lightweight ProductRequestSession aggregate. No catalog, maps or retailer APIs required.
domainContext: TargetProduct, ProductRequest, Observation<string>, Confidence. Maintains the current target for VisualSearch and Guidance.

milestones.title: Speech to text (push-to-talk)
milestones.description: A spoken phrase becomes text locally for short commands.

milestones.title: Intent and target extraction
milestones.description: Text 'Ich suche ...' yields a normalized TargetProduct.

tasks.title: Define SpeechInputPort and TargetProduct value object
acceptanceCriteria: Domain tests run with a dummy speech adapter, no hardware.

tasks.title: Implement rule-based product intent parser
acceptanceCriteria: 'Ich suche X' and variants produce TargetProduct(X).
Saying a product name reliably sets the current target offline.
Ambiguous input triggers a spoken clarification instead of a guess.

risks.mitigation: Push-to-talk, short expected phrases, optional cloud fallback.

safetyImplications: A misheard target must be confirmable before guidance begins.
accessibilityImplications: The entire entry flow is voice-only with no visual requirement.
privacyImplications: Audio processed ephemerally; no recording stored.
verificationRequirements: Unit tests with dummy and local adapters.
Network-isolation test for the local STT adapter.

decisionLog.decision: Local STT can use whisper.cpp-audio-decision (/v1/audio/decisions) with keyword intent plus transcribe fallback; Web Speech remains the zero-install fallback.
decisionLog.rationale: Direct intent with calibrated abstain/coverage plus a transcript for fuzzy product resolution; inline schemas must set abstain thresholds.
